name: p2-end-portal-frame
notes: P2 (corrupt-events): the bedrock breaker's swap against an end portal frame (survival-unbreakable). Piston up on the frame, torch beside it. In ONE window: break the torch (queues the retract in the packet phase), break the piston, place a piston facing down. The queued retract runs on the new piston and removeBlocks the frame. Same geometry and stance as designs/bedrock/scenarios/torch-3-actions.json.
